QuestInfo.name: [Home] Amy's Ingredients
QuestInfo.0: Alvin was tasked with going to the market for supplies, but instead he's standing around looking lost. You should talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Alvin says the market is out of Lemons and Apples. He asks you to go to a General Store in another town to buy them. Go buy Lemon x5 and Apple x5, and return to Alvin.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the Lemons and Apples to Alvin.

default.0: Bring me 5 Apples and Lemons each! And make sure it's the good stuff. They need to be tradable!
